title: Kokanu in lika Hanci
summary: It is Kokanu anyhow. nin je Kokanu ’s zeal being undermined by the one-size-fits-all attempts to not distinguish word formation and syntax, there is still great need to renovate the Hanzi/Kanji transliteration. And here it goes. Still, it bears maximal inter-intelligibility with the Second Polling Scheme of toki pona.
content:
It is Kokanu anyhow. nin je Kokanu’s zeal being undermined by the one-size-fits-all attempts to not distinguish word formation and syntax, there is still great need to renovate the Hanzi/Kanji transliteration. And here it goes.

Still, it bears maximal inter-intelligibility with the Second Polling Scheme of toki pona.
